At first glance this website is a Reddit clone and I honestly thought that was all it would be when I first made my account. But then I started visiting threads, entering comment sections, and I realized that Voat has one thing that Reddit hasn't had for a very long time.

Voat for me has been a place to say whatever I want to. On Reddit half of the time (especially with submissions) I'm reluctant to hit the submit button because I'm worried over what the response will be. A lot of the time on Reddit people will downvote and attack you for anything but here I haven't made a single submission that has gotten downvoted even if it went against the popular opinion.

On the same note, Voat shows actual votes on submissions and comments and it's pretty goddamn awesome to see when something has over 100 upvoats and 0 downvoats. I feel like this community is much, much more accepting and friendly than Voat.

When I originally made my account I didn't think I'd stick around. I thought I'd check out this place and see what was going on around here but I'm pretty sure that I'm going to be a Voat regular for now on.
